text:
Noah Rivera: Voyager Health emailed an RFI asking for capability matrix + short answers around HSM, VPC peering, and data residency. They want a POC quote and a one-page security summary. Uploaded: s3://redwood-sales/voyager/rfi/voyager-rfi-2026.pdf

Maya Chen: Suggested POC: 3 business days (ingest, perf/scale, handoff). Include test corpus, eval harness, and a calendar of milestones. I'll build the capability matrix with explicit limitation notes.

Eliot Park: For pricing propose $3.5k credits + $1k infra stipend if on-prem kit required. If they convert to Dedicated within 30 days, offer a 20% credit toward first invoice. Need expected QPS and token volume to firm estimate.

Noah Rivera: They answered scope: ~80 concurrent sessions peak, ~3k embeddings/day, retention requirement: EU-only storage. Also asked if we permit customer-managed HSM and key export.

Eliot Park: Security: we support BYOK into customer HSMs (PKCS#11/CloudHSM). We do NOT allow export of private key material from HSM. Hosted customers can request dedicated encryption controls via enterprise contract. FedRAMP is not yet available; we'll propose Dedicated tenancy + SOC2 reports as compensating controls.

Rory (legal-bot): NDA + DPA required before ingestion. Pen-test allowed but needs 10 business days notice and scoped plan. I'll upload the SOW template.

Maya Chen: Draft matrix columns: Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private (VPC/on-prem) | Notes. Rows include: tenant isolation, per-tenant KMS, HSM import, VPC peering, data residency controls, retention & audit logs, SLA.

Ops (deploy-bot): Calendar: tentative POC kickoff 2026-06-02 11:00 UTC — invite sent to voyager-contact@voyagerhealth.com.

Maya Chen: Example eval curl for embeddings to include in deliverable:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["sample doc"]}'

Eliot Park: I'll upload pricing line items and runbook to s3://redwood-sales/voyager/deliverables/ by EOD. Please review quick so we can return RFI tomorrow.

Noah Rivera: Thanks — legal & finance aligned, proceed to send. :thumbsup:
